data.body: Lane f041, 2026-10-19: plan refreshed. The code stories now clean every teaching surface themselves, so reverting the docs story no longer makes the scan red; the red run restores docs/user-guide.md from c0cf1022671 instead. A draft of the test ran on story cubistic-patrician-deer's tree (914beb80203): the hint/route half passes, and the scan found exactly one line, docs/user-guide.md:659, which names the older 'rebar bridge-status' alias; the plan rewords that line rather than hard-coding an exclusion.
